help_probe.stdout:
Sorts debug symbols into the right structure for symbolicator

Usage: symsorter-Windows-x86_64.exe [OPTIONS] --output <PATH> [INPUT]...

Arguments:
  [INPUT]...  Path to input files

Options:
  -o, --output <PATH>          Path to the output folder structure
  -p, --prefix <PREFIX>        The prefix to use
  -b, --bundle-id <BUNDLE_ID>  The bundle ID to use
      --multiple-bundles       Derive the bundle ID from the first folder
      --with-sources           If enable the system will attempt to create source bundles
  -z, --compress...            If enabled debug symbols will be zstd compressed (repeat to increase compression)
  -I, --ignore-errors          Ignore broken archives
  -q, --quiet                  If enabled output will be suppressed
  -h, --help                   Print help
  -V, --version                Print version
